line: Almost nobody can tell you where the chatbot ends.
A chatbot gives a reply . That's the job.
An agent acts — it plans the steps itself.
Then it uses real tools, checks the result, and goes again.
Same three steps, on a loop. Plan .
Act — with a tool that touches something real.
That loop is the entire difference.
If it can't act without you , it's a chatbot with a new name.
The honest part: agents don't fail like chatbots.
They fail with total confidence , halfway through.
So build one that touches something you can undo .
Next: an n8n agent , end to end.
Follow so it lands in front of you.
